lines.zh: 深海里我几乎不摆鳍，只让外套膜一收一放。
lines.en: In the deep I barely fin; my mantle squeezes and releases.

lines.zh: 绯红的壳贴着海底滑，像一块会走的石头。
lines.en: My crimson shell slides along the seabed like walking stone.

lines.zh: 深海太黑，我只能靠水压认路。
lines.en: The deep is dark; I navigate by water pressure alone.

lines.zh: 一两只同行，再多就挤了。
lines.en: One or two of us travel together; more would crowd.

lines.zh: 我把触腕收到壳下，走得慢但不留痕。
lines.en: I tuck my arms under the shell and leave no trace.

lines.zh: 壳是我的房子，也是我的重量。
lines.en: The shell is my house and also my weight.

lines.zh: 我漂过去时，泥沙只翻起一点点。
lines.en: As I drift by, the silt barely stirs at all.

lines.zh: 深海的水压帮我合紧壳口。
lines.en: Deep-sea pressure helps me keep the shell sealed.

lines.zh: 绯红的壳上有一道旧裂，早就长好了。
lines.en: An old crack on my crimson shell healed long ago.

lines.zh: 我宁可慢，也不浮到有光的地方。
lines.en: I'd rather be slow than rise toward the light.

lines.zh: 两只并肩走，壳沿会轻轻磕响。
lines.en: Side by side, our shell rims clink softly.

lines.zh: 海底的坡我走得很稳，壳先探出去。
lines.en: On the seabed slope I move steady, shell first.

lines.zh: 我的触腕从不伸直，只贴着壳边探。
lines.en: My arms never stretch, only probe along the shell.

lines.zh: 深海里能走的，都不着急。
lines.en: In the deep, anything that walks is in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我压低壳沿，从岩脊上滑过去。
lines.en: I lower my shell rim and slide over the ridge.

lines.zh: 触腕探到暖水，我就往冷处游。
lines.en: A tentacle finds warm water, so I head for the cold.

lines.zh: 我伏在海底，壳口只开一条细缝。
lines.en: I settle on the floor with my shell barely open.

lines.zh: 深处静得能听见自己壳里水在流。
lines.en: The deep is so quiet I hear water within my shell.

lines.zh: 两只挤在一起，谁的壳都不肯让。
lines.en: Two of us pressed together, neither shell yielding.

lines.zh: 我把触腕盘在壳里，像收了线的网。
lines.en: I coil my arms inside, like a net drawn in.

lines.zh: 海底的冷是慢慢渗进壳缝的。
lines.en: The cold of the floor seeps slowly through shell seams.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我和礁石分不清。
lines.en: Still as I am, the reef and I look the same.

lines.zh: 我偶尔喷一口水，把沙吹松。
lines.en: Now and then I squirt water to loosen the sand.

lines.zh: 深海没有季节，我也没日子可数。
lines.en: The deep has no seasons, so I count no days.

lines.zh: 壳里的水一直在换，我却不觉得凉。
lines.en: Water turns over inside my shell; I never feel cold.

lines.zh: 我听着上面的水声，判断有没有人下来。
lines.en: I listen to water above and judge if someone descends.

lines.zh: 绯红的壳在暗里还是能看见一点。
lines.en: Even in the dark, a trace of crimson still shows.

lines.zh: 两只一起缩着，整片海底都安静。
lines.en: Both of us withdrawn, the whole floor falls quiet.

lines.zh: 我不需要光，我的壳知道自己多深。
lines.en: I need no light; my shell knows how deep it is.

lines.zh: 这一层海床，我住了很久。
lines.en: I have lived on this seabed layer a long while.

lines.zh: 你潜这么深，就为了看我一块壳？
lines.en: You dove this deep just to see one shell?

lines.zh: 你的灯照到我，绯红就退了一半。
lines.en: Your lamp hits me, and half my crimson retreats.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的触腕比看起来长。
lines.en: Don't reach; my arms are longer than they look.

lines.zh: 你在上面喘气，我在这里都听见。
lines.en: I hear you breathing up there all the way down here.

lines.zh: 两只都把眼探出来，盯着你的灯。
lines.en: Both of us poke our eyes out and watch your lamp.

lines.zh: 深海的东西不该被光照，你回去吧。
lines.en: Deep things shouldn't be lit; turn back up.

lines.zh: 你的护甲上还带着浅水的味道。
lines.en: Your armor still carries the smell of shallow water.

lines.zh: 我看不见你的脸，只看见一团暖光。
lines.en: I can't see your face, only a warm glow.

lines.zh: 壳里的我听你说话，像隔着石头。
lines.en: Inside my shell your voice sounds like stones between.

lines.zh: 你想撬开我？我的壳自己会夹。
lines.en: You want to pry me? My shell closes by itself.

lines.zh: 壳被敲开一道口，海水灌进来了。
lines.en: A gap splits my shell, and seawater pours in.

lines.zh: 绯红的碎片又掉了一块。
lines.en: Another crimson shard chips off me.

lines.zh: 疼，可我还是把触腕收在壳里。
lines.en: It hurts, but I keep my arms inside the shell.

lines.zh: 我的旧裂旁边又多了一道新的。
lines.en: A new crack now sits beside my old one.

lines.zh: 这样打下去，我的壳撑不了几下。
lines.en: At this rate my shell won't take many more.

lines.zh: 深海的冷顺着伤口钻进来。
lines.en: The deep's cold works its way into the wound.

lines.zh: 你要的就是这块绯红碎片吧。
lines.en: This crimson shard is what you're after, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我缩得更紧了，壳沿都咬进沙里。
lines.en: I pull tighter, shell rim biting into the sand.

lines.zh: 打我的人，通常不会潜第二次。
lines.en: Whoever hits me rarely dives a second time.

lines.zh: 壳还在，我就还没输。
lines.en: The shell holds, so I haven't lost yet.

lines.zh: 海底落下的碎肉味，让我探出触腕。
lines.en: The smell of fallen scraps makes me reach out.

lines.zh: 你把碎鱼丢下来，我壳口开大了一点。
lines.en: You drop fish bits, and my shell opens wider.

lines.zh: 深海很少有食，我闻到就挪过去。
lines.en: Food is rare down here; one scent and I move.

lines.zh: 别拿绯红碎片钓我，那是我身上的。
lines.en: Don't bait me with crimson shards; those are mine.

lines.zh: 两只一起凑近，先到的那只先吃。
lines.en: Both of us close in; the first to arrive eats.

lines.zh: 我的触腕先到，壳才慢慢跟上。
lines.en: My arms arrive first; the shell follows slowly.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，我就不算胆小了。
lines.en: Blood in the water makes me considerably braver.

lines.zh: 你手里那点食，抵不上我游一趟。
lines.en: That scrap in your hand isn't worth my trip.

lines.zh: 深海的规矩：有食就先用触腕卷住。
lines.en: Deep-sea rule: whatever food appears, coil it first.

lines.zh: 我探出半寸，不是信任你。
lines.en: I extend half an inch, and not out of trust.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的壳，声音闷得吓人。
lines.en: You kick my shell, and the sound comes out muffled.

lines.zh: 我的壳被撞歪，壳缝里挤出一股水。
lines.en: My shell tilts and squeezes out a jet of water.

lines.zh: 别推，我收着触腕站不起来。
lines.en: Don't shove; with arms tucked, I can't right myself.

lines.zh: 两只撞在一起，谁也没让开。
lines.en: Two shells collide and neither one gives way.

lines.zh: 你把海底的沙踩起来，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: You stir up the seabed sand and I see nothing.

lines.zh: 壳沿刮过你的靴底，声音很刺耳。
lines.en: My shell rim scrapes your boot sole, grinding loud.

lines.zh: 我退了一点，壳上的旧裂又疼了。
lines.en: I back off, and the old crack aches again.

lines.zh: 你挡着我的路，我只能贴着你过。
lines.en: You block my path, so I squeeze past against you.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，可我的壳薄了一层。
lines.en: It wasn't much, but my shell is thinner now.

lines.zh: 深海的路窄，我们都得侧着壳走。
lines.en: Deep paths are narrow; we all walk sideways here.

lines.zh: 深海太暗，我靠壳沿的震动找同类。
lines.en: The deep is dark; I find my kind by shell rim tremors.

lines.zh: 两只壳对了壳，慢慢并在一起。
lines.en: Two shells meet rim to rim and slowly settle.

lines.zh: 我把触腕伸出去，只伸出一半。
lines.en: I reach my arms out, and only halfway.

lines.zh: 绯红的壳要配同样深红的。
lines.en: A crimson shell should pair with equally deep red.

lines.zh: 一两只成对，深海也就够热闹了。
lines.en: One pair is enough bustle for the deep.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们正贴着壳交换水。
lines.en: Don't disturb us; we're passing water shell to shell.

lines.zh: 我们的壳上都有旧裂，正好对上。
lines.en: We both carry old cracks, and they line up.

lines.zh: 等潮水往下沉，我们就一起走。
lines.en: When the tide sinks, the two of us will move on.

lines.zh: 她先开壳，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: She opens her shell first, and only then I approach.

lines.zh: 深海的亲事，安静得像两块石头。
lines.en: Deep-sea courtship is as quiet as two stones.

lines.zh: 你把我抱起来，壳里的水全乱了。
lines.en: You lift me, and the water inside my shell sloshes.

lines.zh: 离开深海的水压，我的壳开始发胀。
lines.en: Away from the deep's pressure, my shell starts swelling.

lines.zh: 你会拿走我掉的那块绯红碎片吗。
lines.en: Will you take the crimson shard I dropped?

lines.zh: 把我放进桶里，我会一路沉到底。
lines.en: Put me in a bucket and I'll sink to the bottom.

lines.zh: 你的手里太暖，我的触腕缩回去了。
lines.en: Your hand is too warm; my arms have pulled back.

lines.zh: 轻点，壳裂了不会自己好得那么快。
lines.en: Easy; a cracked shell doesn't heal quickly.

lines.zh: 我在你手里还在喷水，抱歉。
lines.en: I'm still squirting water in your hand; sorry.

lines.zh: 别晒我，深海的壳经不起太阳。
lines.en: Don't sun me; deep-sea shells can't take sunlight.

lines.zh: 放我回暗处，我就能自己找路。
lines.en: Set me in the dark and I'll find my own way.

lines.zh: 一只壳沉甸甸的，你的手会酸。
lines.en: One shell is heavy; your arms will ache.

lines.zh: 有东西压低了水，我把壳合到最紧。
lines.en: Something lowers the water; I clamp my shell tight.

lines.zh: 我感觉到那双眼睛，就在礁石后面。
lines.en: I feel those eyes watching from behind the reef.

lines.zh: 是同类还是捕食者，我听壳的声音。
lines.en: Friend or hunter? I listen to the shell's sound.

lines.zh: 两只同时不动，这是我们的判断。
lines.en: Both of us freeze at once; that's our judgment.

lines.zh: 我把触腕全收进去了，只剩眼睛。
lines.en: I've drawn all arms in; only my eyes remain.

lines.zh: 那股水流不对，是从上面压下来的。
lines.en: That current is wrong; it presses down from above.

lines.zh: 我认得这种靠近的节奏。
lines.en: I know this particular rhythm of approach.

lines.zh: 壳缝里透进一点光，我知道有人来了。
lines.en: Light leaks through my shell seam; someone is here.

lines.zh: 我不打算跑，深海里跑不掉。
lines.en: I won't run; you can't outrun anything down here.

lines.zh: 先看，再决定要不要开壳。
lines.en: First I look, then I decide whether to open.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，壳口张开一条细缝。
lines.en: I watch you with my shell open a hair.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，得先撬开这层绯红。
lines.en: To take me you must pry this crimson layer first.

lines.zh: 我在往礁石堆里退，一寸一寸。
lines.en: I'm backing into the rocks, an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 两只都盯着你，谁也不先动。
lines.en: Both of us stare; neither moves first.

lines.zh: 水压一变，我就知道你要伸手。
lines.en: When the pressure shifts, I know your hand is coming.

lines.zh: 我的触腕在壳下慢慢张开了。
lines.en: Under the shell, my arms are slowly opening.

lines.zh: 别以为我慢，我喷水的力气不小。
lines.en: Don't think me slow; my water jet hits hard.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我退半步，很公平。
lines.en: You take one step, I take half; quite fair.

lines.zh: 我在算还能撑多久的气。
lines.en: I'm counting how much air I have left.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就把壳死死夹住。
lines.en: One step closer and my shell clamps shut.

lines.zh: 我的触腕缠上你的手腕，很凉。
lines.en: My arms wrap your wrist, and they're cold.

lines.zh: 一股水喷在你脸上，这就是我的攻击。
lines.en: A jet of water in your face; that's my attack.

lines.zh: 壳口一合，把你的指尖夹在里面。
lines.en: My shell shuts with your fingertip caught inside.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，只用触腕上的小钩划。
lines.en: I don't bite; I only scrape with arm hooks.

lines.zh: 你捏我，我就喷墨一样喷水。
lines.en: Squeeze me and I jet water like ink.

lines.zh: 绯红的壳撞你的膝盖，闷响一声。
lines.en: My crimson shell rams your knee with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 两只一起缠，你一只手不够用。
lines.en: Two of us wrap you; one hand won't be enough.

lines.zh: 我打不赢，但我的壳很硬。
lines.en: I can't win, but my shell is very hard.

lines.zh: 退开点，触腕上的钩会留痕。
lines.en: Stand back; the hooks on my arms leave marks.

lines.zh: 这一下是想让你别再来深海。
lines.en: This one is to keep you out of the deep.

lines.zh: 深海底部裂开一道缝，我从里面挤出来。
lines.en: A crack opens on the deep floor and I squeeze out.

lines.zh: 我在没有光的地方出生，壳先长硬。
lines.en: I'm born where there's no light; the shell hardens first.

lines.zh: 一只或两只，我们从不成群。
lines.en: One or two of us, never a bigger crowd.

lines.zh: 水深到我这里，已经看不见上面。
lines.en: The water here is deep enough to hide the surface.

lines.zh: 我落下来时，海水把我压得几乎不动。
lines.en: When I land, the sea presses me almost still.

lines.zh: 这一层海底没什么吃的，但很安静。
lines.en: This layer of the floor offers little food but quiet.

lines.zh: 我出生时壳是软的，绯红要慢慢才生出来。
lines.en: My shell starts soft; the crimson comes on slowly.

lines.zh: 别把我放到浅水，那里太亮。
lines.en: Don't put me in shallows; it's far too bright.

lines.zh: 深海的第一次呼吸，是通过壳缝。
lines.en: My first deep breath came through the shell seam.

lines.zh: 我从暗处冒出来，连自己都看不清。
lines.en: I rise out of the dark and can't see myself.

lines.zh: 深海的壳没见过火，一碰就裂。
lines.en: A deep-sea shell has never met fire; it splits on contact.

lines.zh: 我从水压里被拽出来，壳在响。
lines.en: Dragged out of the pressure, my shell creaks.

lines.zh: 我在水里却吸不到水，很奇怪。
lines.en: I'm in water yet can't draw it in; strange.

lines.zh: 这一炸把我的壳震得发麻。
lines.en: The blast leaves my shell ringing numb.

lines.zh: 箭尖顶进壳里，海水从缝里冒泡。
lines.en: The arrowhead sinks in, and seawater bubbles from the seam.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的绯红褪成灰。
lines.en: That light bleaches my crimson to grey.

lines.zh: 深海里找不到食，壳都轻了。
lines.en: No food in the deep; even my shell feels lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打进深海，我的触腕全缩回去。
lines.en: Lightning reaches the deep, and every arm retracts.

lines.zh: 这里没有水压，我的壳自己散了。
lines.en: No pressure here, and my shell comes apart.
